baseline.price_basis: Last completed hourly OHLC close before cohort start; historical ask/spread unavailable

benchmark_method: Fund entry fee inside benchmark capital; mark current public best bid less exit fee. Historical OHLC entry is a proxy, not a reconstructed executable fill.
history_start_reason: Forward collection from first telemetry write; no complete historical per-model liquidation snapshots exist
retention_note: One immutable point per bucket; rolling retention drops oldest points after limit
